3. Allocate a dedicated high‑throughput network segment or increase NIC capacity for replication traffic.  
4. Reduce index size and replication load by performing more frequent, smaller segment merges instead of nightly full optimizations.  
5. Add additional replica nodes gradually and balance them across multiple zones to spread replication load and avoid single‑point bandwidth saturation.
